summary: Your page offers a free consultation and names a strong team, but the contact details disagree and the main button does not lead to a visible form.

findings.problem: Header and footer list 647-348-6723, but the Call Us Here button dials 647-362-2346.
findings.cost: Callers reach a different number, so some enquiries are lost.

findings.problem: Book a Free Consultation points to #request and no form fields appear. There is no WhatsApp option.
findings.cost: The free consultation is your main offer, and visitors who cannot find the form leave.
findings.fix: A short booking form linked to your calendar.

findings.problem: Social icons link to #, the text [PURCHASE] appears, and a field reads Leave this Blank if are sentient.
findings.cost: Leftover template text makes a law firm look unmaintained.

findings.problem: The menu and testimonials appear twice, one testimonial repeats, the same stock photo is used twice, and there are typos such as very detailed oriented.
findings.cost: Repeats and typos weaken trust when clients compare firms.
findings.fix: One testimonial wall and proofread copy.

redesign: One phone number, one booking form and a calendar link on every page.
A clean testimonial wall, team profiles with photos and proofread copy.
